title: Sean Payton on struggling Broncos offense and play-calling after loss to 49ers: 'We gotta figure it out fast'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton on struggling Broncos offense and play-calling after loss to 49ers: 'We gotta figure it out fast'
sources.description: For the fourth time in four games this season, the Denver Broncos got off to a slow start on offense. This time, they couldn't dig themselves out of a hole.
